cards.title: Prospective Human PTA as Scenario-Based Simulation
cards.claim: Human PTA simulations in this project are prospective scenarios based on PopPK models and assumed variability, not observations of the target drug in humans. They require explicit assumptions about human PK variability and PD targets. PTA is not a measure of clinical cure.
conditions: Target drug has no human PK/PD observations.
PD targets must be qualified for human applicability.
Simulation must account for infection-related PK changes if relevant.
required_inputs: Qualified PD target with human applicability assessment.
limitations: Sensitive to assumptions about human IIV and PD target transferability.
cards.downstream_use: Dose regimen selection for clinical trials; PK/PD cutoff determination.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
